title: How an AI deepfake ad of MrBeast ended up on TikTok
supports_claim: TechCrunch reports a deepfake video and voice impersonation of creator MrBeast ran as a TikTok ad in October 2023 offering a '$2 iPhone' scam, and that TikTok removed the ad and requires synthetic media in ads to be disclosed.
limitations: Single-outlet news report; does not identify who created the deepfake or publish verified view counts, click-through, or confirmed victim financial loss.

title: Two voice actors sue AI company over claims it breached contracts and cloned their voices
supports_claim: CBS News reports voice actors Paul Skye Lehrman and Linnea Sage filed a proposed class-action lawsuit alleging Lovo cloned and commercially reused their voices beyond the stated internal-research purpose they consented to.
limitations: Reports on a filed complaint's allegations, not an adjudicated court finding of liability; the defendant did not comment for the story; the plaintiff's reported income-loss figure is self-reported, not independently audited.

title: Federal Trade Commission Announces Updated Advertising Guides to Combat Deceptive Reviews and Endorsements
supports_claim: FTC announces its finalized Endorsement Guides update explicitly extending fake/deceptive-endorsement prohibitions to AI-generated reviews and fabricated endorsers, later backed by a binding final rule effective 2024-10-21.
limitations: Guides and rule govern reviews/endorsements and are U.S.-only; they do not specifically address video dubbing or synthetic-audio disclosure on video platforms.

title: How we're helping creators disclose altered or synthetic content
supports_claim: YouTube's own policy blog states creators must disclose when realistic content is made with altered or synthetic media, including generative AI, and that YouTube may itself label or take enforcement action on undisclosed content.
limitations: First-party platform announcement describing YouTube's own policy design and intent; it is not an independent audit of how consistently the policy is enforced across all creators.

title: First-ever Law on Artificial Intelligence approved
supports_claim: Vietnam's National Assembly approved Law No. 134/2025/QH15 on Artificial Intelligence, effective 2026-03-01, which the article states addresses emerging issues including AI-generated content and cross-border AI platform responsibilities.
limitations: Article confirms the law covers AI-generated content but does not detail the specific disclosure or labeling obligations that would apply to a content-creation product; full statutory text and implementing decisions must be checked separately.

title: EU AI Act regulatory framework: transparency obligations and implementation timeline
supports_claim: The European Commission states the AI Act requires deepfakes and AI-generated content to be clearly and visibly labelled, and confirms these transparency rules came into effect and began enforcement in August 2026.
limitations: Official policy summary page; exact scope of which creator tools/outputs count as in-scope 'deepfakes' under Article 50 requires checking the full Act text and Commission guidelines, not just this summary page.
